name: Geodude
description: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user rolls into the target to deal damage, then becomes fixated on using this move.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, raising its defensive stats.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user tramples its target into the ground, dealing damage. This also lowers the target’s action speed.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user launches countless stones at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.description: The user causes an explosion to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.
